en.title: Investable Periods
en.description:
Given daily prices, a target minimum price, and a target maximum price, count the contiguous subarrays whose minimum is exactly the target minimum price and whose maximum is exactly the target maximum price.

See below for this site's input/output protocol; the source repository's solution is not executed.
en.input: The first line contains n min_price max_price, and the next line contains n prices. 1≤n≤100000, 1≤price[i]≤10^9, 1≤min_price≤max_price≤10^9.
en.output: Output the number of qualifying contiguous ranges. The answer may exceed the range of a 32-bit signed integer, so use a 64-bit integer.
en.explanation: The source's three examples can be checked directly; this local problem counts closed-range subarrays, and the maximum and minimum must each exactly equal their targets.
